definitions.explanation: A group of people united by a common cause, ideology, or allegiance. Often used in political, competitive, or adversarial contexts to describe opposing sides.
A temporary base or camp set up by military forces. The original meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧{陣営|じんえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧{陣営|じんえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なっている→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The claims of both sides differ greatly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陣営|じんえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}えた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: During the election campaign, each faction desperately appealed for support.
They set up camp on the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陣営|じんえい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{奇襲|きしゅう}→奇襲：12193_kishuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: They launched a surprise attack on the enemy camp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陣営|じんえい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}り→戻る：01117_modoru⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}った→練る：09751_neru⟧。
examples.english: The general returned to camp and devised the next strategy.

notes:
In modern usage, sense 1 (faction/side) is far more common than sense 2 (military camp). Frequently appears in news about politics, elections, and international relations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧{陣営|じんえい} (both sides/camps)
- ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧{陣営|じんえい} / ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧{陣営|じんえい} (ruling party camp / opposition camp)
- {陣営|じんえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to set up camp)
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧{陣営|じんえい} (the opposing side)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陣地|じんち}→陣地：30721_jinchi⟧ focuses on the physical location (position/territory)
- {陣営|じんえい} emphasizes the group of people or the faction
